podcast.title: Second Wave of Club Culture
podcast.body: Euro Trance is mentioned as part of the "second wave of club culture" that swept through the mid-1990s, alongside Techno, Acid House, House, and Progressive, marking a significant period for club music. "el Euro Trans, vienen como un montón de envenimientos aquí en España."
